canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Delin Soreth: 36-year-old man, 161 cm (short), exceptional bodybuilder construction with enormous but coherent human muscle mass, skin value band-1-lightest. Face: angular diamond face; wide-set eyes and a low straight brow; crooked healed nose, balanced mouth; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: violet-plum-pink, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: tailored-longcoat, specifically a cloth longcoat with a readable waist, split hem, plain underlayer, and fitted shoes; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a narrow tattoo cuff; a patterned collar insert. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
